convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'BrakeExp' custom indicator with parameters A and B; relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all position open/close logic; custom indicator buffers require understanding of BrakeExp internals to replicate in Python

derived_values.used_by: BarsCalculated check and bar sufficiency check in OnTick

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade timing

DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar end

other_exits: Long position closed when BrakeExp buffer 1 (DnTrend) is nonzero (trend reversal, no fresh signal needed)
Short position closed when BrakeExp buffer 0 (UpTrend) is nonzero (trend reversal, no fresh signal needed)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM values treated as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 = 0.1 lots); positive MM values treated as deposit share fraction (money management mode handled in TradeAlgorithms.mqh)

custom_logic_notes: The BrakeExp indicator has 4 buffers: buffer0=UpTrend, buffer1=DnTrend, buffer2=UpSignal, buffer3=DnSignal. Signal buffers produce non-zero values on signal bars only; Trend buffers are non-zero during sustained trend periods. Exit logic has two tiers: (1) on a fresh DnSignal, close longs AND open shorts; (2) on DnTrend being nonzero (without fresh DnSignal), close longs only. Symmetric logic for short exits. The EA uses a static Recount flag to force recalculation on data errors or insufficient bars. When SignalBar=0, the EA processes signals on every tick rather than only on new bars. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans are input gates that can disable entry or exit independently per direction.
python_conversion_notes: The BrakeExp custom indicator must be ported to Python or its logic reverse-engineered from its .mq5 source. The 4-buffer scheme (UpTrend, DnTrend, UpSignal, DnSignal) needs faithful reproduction. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles all position management including the conditional MM logic (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction), position opening/closing with deviation, SL/TP application, and the signal time-based logic in BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen. The signal time (SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec) is passed to trade functions suggesting the library may use it for pending order or bar-identification logic. SL/TP values are in points (not pips); for 5-digit brokers these are already point-adjusted (1000 points = 100 pips for 5-digit, 1000 pips for 4-digit). Verify whether TradeAlgorithms.mqh applies any digit correction internally.
